Model defines an interface with common methods that all db models should have.

## core.BaseModel

BaseModel defines a base struct that is intended to be embedded into other custom models.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | <code>string</code> | Id is the primary key of the model. It is usually autogenerated by the parent model implementation. |
| `lastSavedPK()` | <code>(): any</code> | LastSavedPK returns the last saved primary key of the model. |
| `pk()` | <code>(): any</code> |  |
| `isNew()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | IsNew indicates what type of db query (insert or update) should be used with the model instance. |
| `markAsNew()` | <code>(): void</code> | MarkAsNew clears the pk field and marks the current model as "new" (aka. forces m.IsNew() to be true). |
| `markAsNotNew()` | <code>(): void</code> | MarkAsNew set the pk field to the Id value and marks the current model as NOT "new" (aka. forces m.IsNew() to be false). |
| `postScan()` | <code>(): void</code> | PostScan implements the [`dbx.postScanner`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxpostscanner) interface. |

## core.RecordFieldResolver

RecordFieldResolver defines a custom search resolver struct for
managing Record model search fields.

Usually used together with `search.Provider`.
Example:

```
	resolver := resolvers.NewRecordFieldResolver(
	    app,
	    myCollection,
	    &models.RequestInfo{...},
	    true,
	)
	provider := search.NewProvider(resolver)
	...
```

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `allowedFields()` | <code>(): Array&lt;string&gt;</code> | AllowedFields returns a copy of the resolver's allowed fields. |
| `setAllowedFields()` | <code>(newAllowedFields: Array&lt;string&gt;): void</code> | SetAllowedFields replaces the resolver's allowed fields with the new ones. |
| `allowHiddenFields()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | AllowHiddenFields returns whether the current resolver allows filtering hidden fields. |
| `setAllowHiddenFields()` | <code>(allowHiddenFields: boolean): void</code> | SetAllowHiddenFields enables or disables hidden fields filtering. |
| `updateQuery()` | <code>(query: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/dbx#dbxselectquery">dbx.SelectQuery</a>): void</code> |  |
| `resolve()` | <code>(fieldName: string): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/search#searchresolverresult">search.ResolverResult</a>)</code> | Resolve implements `search.FieldResolver` interface. |

## core.RecordProxy

RecordProxy defines an interface for a Record proxy/project model,
aka. custom model struct that acts on behalve the proxied Record to
allow for example typed getter/setters for the Record fields.

To implement the interface it is usually enough to embed the [`BaseRecordProxy`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#corebaserecordproxy) struct.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `proxyRecord()` | <code>(): (<a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#corerecord">Record</a>)</code> | ProxyRecord returns the proxied Record model. |
| `setProxyRecord()` | <code>(record: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#corerecord">Record</a>): void</code> | SetProxyRecord loads the specified record model into the current proxy. |
